newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quotes not comparable, no trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quotes not comparable, no trade.

text.p: U.S. barge rates for nearby positions quoted on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange were not comparable with Tuesday's values, while deferred rates were down slightly.
No barges traded versus four trades Tuesday.
- Four barges, Illinois River, two each week of May 18 and 25, no bid, offered 105 percent of tariff - no comparison.
- Four barges, mid Mississippi River (McGregor and south), one each week of June, bid 107-1/2 percent - no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, upper Mississippi (St Paul-Savage), one each week of June, bid 135 percent of tariff - no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Mississippi (Osceola to Cairo), one each week of September, bid 132-1/2 percent - unchanged, offered 140 percent - unchanged.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week of September, bid 150 percent, offered 160 - no comparison on either value.
- Four barges, mid Mississippi, one each week of October, bid 217-1/2 percent - down 2-1/2 percentage points, offered 225 - no comparison.
